description: QC Technician Position Summary The QC Technician supports quality control testing activities for raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products within a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This position performs laboratory testing, sample preparation, data documentation, and quality evaluations to ensure products meet established specifications and quality standards. The role provides excellent opportunities for recent graduates and early-career scientists to develop analytical chemistry, instrumentation, and quality systems expertise through hands-on laboratory experience and structured training. Key Responsibilities Perform quality control testing on incoming raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products according to established procedures. Conduct routine physical property and wet chemistry testing, including pH, viscosity, TOC, and related analytical evaluations. Prepare samples, standards, reagents, and volumetric solutions for laboratory analysis. Collect, analyze, document, and communicate test results accurately and in accordance with laboratory procedures. Review laboratory and production records for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP) and GMP requirements. Enter, retrieve, and maintain testing data within laboratory information management systems (LIMS). Assist with investigations related to out-of-specification (OOS), out-of-trend (OOT), and customer complaint findings. Support laboratory housekeeping activities, including equipment cleaning, glassware maintenance, and waste disposal. Collaborate with Production, Quality Assurance, Engineering, and other departments to support product quality and manufacturing operations. Follow all laboratory safety procedures and quality requirements. Growth & Development Opportunities With training, this role will expand into: HPLC, GC, LC, and additional instrumental analytical testing. Method development and method transfer activities. Instrument calibration, qualification, and validation support (IQ/OQ/PQ). Stability testing programs. SOP development, review, and revision. Laboratory troubleshooting and continuous improvement initiatives. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or another related scientific discipline. Laboratory experience through academic coursework, undergraduate research, internships, co-ops, or industry experience. Understanding of basic analytical chemistry principles and laboratory practices. Experience with sample preparation, solution preparation, and laboratory documentation. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Ability to accurately record observations, test results, and laboratory activities. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Microbiology Lab Analyst Job Description The Microbiology Lab Analyst serves as a Laboratory Technician responsible for performing analytical and microbiological testing on food products, ingredients, and environmental samples to support quality and safety programs. You will apply approved microbiological techniques and methodologies to ensure accurate, reliable results and help maintain compliance with regulatory and customer requirements. Working primarily on second shift, you will prepare and analyze samples, maintain a clean and organized laboratory, monitor and care for equipment, and assist with inventory and quality-related duties. Responsibilities Perform analytical and microbiological testing of food products, ingredients, and environmental samples in accordance with approved methods and protocols. Apply approved microbiological techniques and methodologies to evaluate indicator organisms, pathogens, and relevant chemistries. Prepare and analyze samples for indicator organisms, pathogens, and chemical parameters, ensuring accuracy and proper documentation. Notify laboratory management promptly of any deviations, out-of-specification results, or unusual findings in test results. Maintain appropriate inventory levels of reagents, media, consumables, and supplies required for testing activities. Provide routine preventive maintenance, basic troubleshooting, and thorough cleaning of laboratory equipment to ensure reliable operation. Support quality-related duties, including performing temperature checks, monitoring controls, and verifying proper storage conditions. Adhere to company policies, procedures, and customer requirements while following relevant regulatory and industry guidelines. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment using proper aseptic techniques and good laboratory practices. Stay current with scientific literature, emerging technologies, and industry trends related to food microbiology and analytical testing. Accurately record, interpret, and report test results in accordance with laboratory documentation standards. Collaborate with colleagues and other departments to support continuous improvement in laboratory processes and quality systems. Essential Skills Bachelor's degree in biology, chemistry, or a closely related science field. At least 2 years of experience in a commercial food-testing or analytical laboratory. Hands-on experience with microbiological testing of food products, ingredients, or environmental samples. Proficiency in aseptic sampling techniques and routine laboratory procedures. Knowledge of laboratory equipment operation, care, and basic troubleshooting. Familiarity with Good Laboratory Practices (GLP). Working knowledge of OSHA safety requirements in a laboratory environment. Experience with FDA, BAM, APHA, ISO, or USP methods relevant to microbiology or analytical testing. Ability to follow detailed protocols and standard operating procedures accurately. Strong attention to detail

Environmental Lab Analyst Job Description The Environmental Lab Analyst evaluates and processes environmental samples to ensure compliance with regulatory and quality standards. Conduct routine bacteriological testing using standardized procedures and documented quality control protocols. Proficiency in routine bacteriological testing using standardized procedures. Ability to apply aseptic technique consistently to prevent contamination. Experience with analytical chemistry methods and quality control practices. Skill in microbiological plating and handling various sample types and matrices. Attention to detail in sample accessioning, evaluation, and documentation. Ability to follow established protocols while recognizing when method adjustments may be needed. Strong organizational skills to manage multiple samples and tasks in a fast-paced environment. Effective communication skills for collaborating within a laboratory team. Commitment to laboratory safety and quality assurance standards.
